newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bertinotti to meet Prodi early Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bertinotti to meet Prodi early Tuesday.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi will meet Fausto Bertinotti, leader of the hard-left Communist Refoundation party, early on Tuesday, political sources said.
Deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni will also be at the meeting, which comes ahead of two other scheduled meetings between Prodi and his political allies on the mini-budget.
The time of the meeting with Bertinotti was not known.

Communist Refoundation is fiercely opposed to the mini-budget and a leader of the party was quoted in an interview on Monday as saying it might soon have to take difficult decisions over its support for the governement -- something Prodi relies on for a parliamentary majority.

Prodi is due to have lunch with leaders of parties in his centre-left Olive Tree coalition and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini, whose Italian Renewal party is another key ally, at 1200 GMT. At 1400 GMT, he meets parliamentary party leaders from the whole ruling majority -- including Communist Refoundation.

Prodi is preparing a mini-budget in the next few weeks that could trim as much as 15 trillion lire ($9 billion) off this year's deficit to further Italy's chances of qualifying for membership of a European single currency at its start in 1999. ($1=1,656)
